reviewer: Codex (AI-assisted source review; not an independent human assessor)
rules: A hit must identify a valid source/page and contain all facts required to answer the question, including units, dates, conditions and exceptions.
Accept the original recorded quote or a documented source-verified equivalent quote, consistently across A/B/C.
A redundant lead-in can be omitted if the required facts and their referent remain identifiable from the chunk and explicit question context.
Numbered identifiers such as 7.1.1 and 7.1.2 can identify the requested target without repeating its heading.
Do not assemble multiple partial chunks into a hit for the main metric.
Correct page alone, topic similarity, source knowledge outside the chunk, or high similarity score is not enough.
Keep automatic baseline, review decisions, evidence additions and reviewed metrics separately. Declare that dev review happened after dev retrieval.
Any future test evidence adjudication must apply these same rules, disclose the reviewer and preserve original traces; no tuning/reselection using test results.
